scope: CPU10 versus CPU11 physical-row allocator PTX; static compiler evidence only
counting_rule: Count PTX instruction statements after the expert_tile_base global load and before the first physical-row byte-offset mul.wide; comments, loads, atomics and subsequent addressing excluded.

dataflow.route_shared_offset: (route_slot_base + local_topk) << 2, then add route_phys_rows shared base

limitations: PTX counts are not SASS counts, instruction latency, GPU timing or TTFT evidence.
Seven sites are compiler unroll/tail clones of one source allocation; 84 is their summed static reduction, not an 84-instruction saving for each routed row.
Hash/REG/STACK/SHARED/total-size comparison is reported independently by the parent compiler inspection.
